# The package wizard

This page is for administrators and developers who create packages in the browser. Since October 2026 the package
creation wizard (`/package/create`) is a step wizard built from the shared components of the administration: it
shows where you are, asks for each part in a card, shows errors at their fields, and reviews the whole package before
it is written. What it posts and what it writes did not change. The full description, with every template and
posted name, is [The package wizard](../../../features/6.0/package-wizard.md); this page is the short guide.

![Create package: the four wizards](../../images/help/sp-wizard.webp)

## The four wizards

**Setup > Packages > Create new package** lists the wizards your role may use:

| Wizard | Exports | Steps |
|---|---|---|
| Content class export | class definitions, no content | Content classes to include, Package information, Package maintainer, Package changelog |
| Content object export | nodes or subtrees with their content, optionally classes and templates | Content objects to include, Content object limits, Package information, Package maintainer, Package changelog |
| Extension export | the files of extensions | Extensions to include, Package information, Package maintainer, Package changelog |
| Site style | two stylesheets, images and a thumbnail | Package thumbnail, CSS files, Image files, Package information, Package maintainer, Package changelog |

Choose one and press **Start the wizard**. The Maintainer step is left out when your role may give no maintainer role.
The extension export lists every extension but lets you pick only those exporting is switched on for
(`package.ini [ExtensionExportSettings]`), each other one with its reason.

## Moving through the steps

Each step shows the list of steps at the top (the current one marked, the done ones ticked), "Step n of m", its name
and what it asks for.

| Button | Does |
|---|---|
| **Continue** | checks the step and goes on; on an error the step stays, a summary at the top links each error to its field |
| **Back** | keeps what you entered (when valid) and returns one step; from the first step back to the choice of wizard |
| **Cancel** | returns to the package list; nothing is written |

Enter in a field is Continue. Required fields are checked by the server, so the messages are the ones in the interface
language.

## The pickers

- **Content classes**: a table of every class with a checkbox, identifier and groups, "n of m selected", and a filter
  by name or identifier. A class hidden by the filter keeps its tick.
- **Content objects**: the chosen nodes and subtrees, each with its class and URL. **Add node** and **Add subtree** open
  the content browser; **Remove selected** takes ticked rows out.
- **Options** (content object export): class definitions and templates (with the siteaccesses whose templates go with
  it), versions, languages, and how node assignments and related objects are kept.
- **Extensions**: version, last change and details per extension.
- **Image files** (site style): **Add image** adds a file and stays on the step.

## The common steps

| Step | Asks for | Checked |
|---|---|---|
| Package information | name, summary, description, version, format (Classic XML or JSON), license, host, packager | name a-z, 0-9 and `_`, not taken; summary required; SemVer version of at most 24 characters; license from the list |
| Package maintainer | person, e-mail, role (`package.ini [MaintainerSettings] RoleList[]`: lead, developer, designer, contributor, tester) | name and e-mail required |
| Package changelog | person, e-mail, text | all three required |

## The review and the result

The last step shows the **Review**: name, summary, version, format, license, host, packager and maintainer, and what
the package carries. **Create package** writes it into the `local` repository and opens its page, with **Download**,
**Validate**, **Install** and the other actions ([The package list and package page](the-package-list-and-package-page.md)).

The wizard only writes a package; the site does not change.

## From the content tree

The content tree's **Advanced > Export** opens the content object wizard with the node already chosen:
`/package/create/(creator)/ezcontentobject/(node)/<node id>`, optionally `(subtree)/1`, `(classes)/0|1` and
`(versions)/current|all` (`kernel/package/module.php`). It only fills in the wizard; the package is made when you
confirm its steps. See [The content export menu](../../../bc/6.0/content-export-menu.md).

## Using the result in a site package

The wizard makes the packages a site package requires, never the site package itself (none of the creators writes the
type `site`). To ship its output with your own site package, download it, unpack it into your source repository, give
it a `<vendor>`, and name it in your site package's `<requires>`:
[Creating packages with the wizard](../your-own/creating-packages-with-the-wizard.md).
